description: Toggle drone favorite status in devices panel on desktop: The star button for the selected drone successfully changes its appearance to indicate a favorited state (such as filled or highlighted), and remains in that state.
Toggle favorited drone back to unfavorited state: The star icon changes from the active favorited state back to the inactive/unfavorited state.
Toggle drone favorite status on mobile viewport: The star button changes to the favorited state correctly on the mobile layout without overlapping or touch-target issues.
Favorite multiple independent drones: Both drones show independent favorited states without affecting each other or causing unintended toggles elsewhere in the list.
Verify Mute Alerts toggle is present and disabled by default: The Mute Alerts toggle should be visible and in the disabled (off) state by default.
Verify enabling Mute Alerts suppresses incoming alert banners: Incoming alert banners are suppressed and do not appear on the screen when Mute Alerts is enabled.
Verify muted alerts do not appear in the alerts panel: The alerts panel remains clear of any alerts that arrived while the Mute Alerts toggle was active.
Verify disabling Mute Alerts resumes normal alert display: Incoming alert banners and panel entries are once again displayed normally after disabling the Mute Alerts toggle.
Toggle favorite state on a drone item in desktop view: The star icon for the selected drone successfully toggles to the favorited state, indicating it has been added to favorites.
Toggle favorite state on a drone item in mobile view: The star button correctly registers the tap and switches to the active favorited state on the mobile layout.
Favorite multiple drones independently: Both selected drones show active favorite states while unselected drones remain unfavorited.
Favorite multiple drones independently: Both selected drones show active favorite star icons independently without affecting each other.
Verify Mute Alerts toggle is present in the cockpit: The Mute Alerts toggle is clearly visible and currently set to the disabled state by default.
Enable Mute Alerts toggle: The Mute Alerts toggle visually updates to show it is enabled or active.
Verify incoming alert banners are suppressed when muted: Incoming alert banners do not pop up on the screen and no new entries appear in the alerts panel.
Verify alerts display normally after disabling Mute Alerts: Incoming alert banners appear on the screen and are successfully recorded in the alerts panel once the mute is disabled.
